title: Binary fallback retains the text handler for materialization
reasoning: The advertised binary fallback returns bytes but does not update the detected TEXT file type. Materialization subsequently passes those bytes to TextHandler.write, which opens an uncompressed text stream and writes bytes directly. This raises TypeError after opening and potentially truncating the destination.
reproduction: Read an unknown-extension file containing invalid UTF-8 through InputFile.from_path, then materialize it. Reading succeeds through the fallback, but writing fails with TypeError.
recommendation: Propagate the effective BINARY signature when fallback reading succeeds so subsequent writes preserve the bytes.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included metrics tests do not cover reading and materializing unknown file formats.
suggestedRegressionTest: Round-trip unknown-extension files containing valid UTF-8 and arbitrary binary bytes through both InputFile constructors and materialization; assert byte preservation for binary fallback.
minimumFixScope: Binary fallback signature propagation through InputFile construction.
